Great camera. This was as advertised, like new. I have no complaints. Transferring info from my old Samsung to the S10 was easy. I am happy with the battery life and the amount of storage. I LOVE the camera! Definitely better than the S9. I especially love the wide angle lense option.

Fantastic phone!. I have been using this phone for a few weeks now, and I am extremely happy with it. The sound and picture quality are great, the photos are wonderful, the battery life is outstanding. The only thing I didn't like is the location of the fingerprint sensor. I'm used to the sensor being on the back of the phone and find it convenient. This phone (S10) has the sensor on the front. But that's not enough to not give it a full 5-star rating!

I use it for social media posts for my job, and the improved detail in my pictures is noticeable. I included a close up photo of a magnolia flower I took while getting the feel for it. I love the fine detail, it doesn't get "muddy" even when I increase the size of the image.

To be updated. I would like to start off by saying I have been using the phone for 24 hours so far and will update my review if anything changes. The only downside is that the battery drains kind of quickly. It's not the worst, but it certainly isn't great. If you're not using it, the battery won't just sit there and drain fast. Awesome upgrade!. I have been using a Samsung Galaxy S8 for over 3 years and finally decided to upgrade. It was a great decision! I love the S10! The screen is bigger, but the phone still feels light and thin. The quality of the pictures is amazing, love the camera! VERY HAPPY!

Samsung has the best displays, what can you say?. I'm pretty adept with cell phone tech, and I read and watch reviews just like all of you are. BUT STOP READING! The truth is, you need to check these out in person. Just go to Best Buy, ignore the blue shirts (or humor them), and play with the silly things. I hated the idea of a bulky display, but I wanted to adapt from the S8. I haven't regretted it. The Pixel 4 is bulkier, and Samsung hardware, display pixel count, and battery life just can't be beat. The cameras are also incredible. The main con with this phone is the somewhat suspect fingerprint reader (STILL BETTER THAN ON THE BACK!) and the power button placement, but you can remedy this with phone updates and screen apps to turn off the display. Small problems, but they might throw some people.

So glad I ordered these!. There are a lot of similar flash drives available here on Amazon and I know it's difficult to make your purchase decision based solely on other reviews or images. But... if you're looking for a high-quality flash drive that supports both USB-C and USB-A, this is definitely the one to buy. I purchased two (different storage sizes) and I couldn't be happier. I believe the battery life is near the new condition level, as seen through the Samsung Members app, and by my own estimates. The fingerprint sensor could take some getting used to, it's advised to register the same preferred finger 2 or more times to improve the hit-rate, and i've done that and it works (samsung is planning an update in the near future to improve this. that's all for now.

Excellent phone, had for over a month, no issues whatsoever. I'm not sure what's up with all of the poor reviews and ratings--this phone worked absolutely perfectly straight out of the box. It takes amazing pictures from the back AND the front, holds a lot of stuff, and all my apps work far better on this than they did on my old phone. I switched from a different brand of Android phone, and everything transferred via USBc cable except my text messages, which were easy to port from the old phone using a free app. The only downside was having to install over two dozen updates (not exaggerating), which was tedious, but I got through all of them in a couple of days, it was really easy despite being time-consuming, and it was worth it for the security patches alone. A few things to keep in mind: - This is a VERIZON phone.

Pleasantly surprised. I'm just not the type who will spend $1200 for latest/bleeding edge gadget, but my old phone was so slow that I feel like I had to upgrade. For the price, I did not expect much from this phone, but I was definitely pleasantly surprised at the condition and performance of this refurbished phone. I watched and read a few reviews before buying and most of the reviews rave about how this phone is still a good buy, even in 2021. The exterior condition is very good, the battery life is decent (lasts me the whole day), the speed/performance is much better than what I had before, the camera is excellent. For the price, I'm very happy with this purchase, even though it's not the latest/greatest kid in the block, it will serve me a few good years.
